author: Raph_friend
quote: You’re not gonna find a bigger die-hard GTA fan than me. I’ve been loyal to this franchise since day one—GTA 1, London 1969, 2, 3, right up to GTA V, where I’ve sunk over 4,000 hours across PC, PS5, and Xbox. Never in a million years did I think Rockstar would drop a game as rough and unpolished as GTA 6. The whole experience has been a massive letdown, and I cannot recommend it in its current state. Capping a flagship title at 30 FPS in 2026 is straight-up unforgivable.

author: Raph_friend
quote: It's a good game, but 30 FPS in 2026 is completely unacceptable. I'll just wait for a performance mode.

author: Raph_friend
quote:
Imagine waiting for your favorite game's upgrade and getting 30 FPS AGAIN! 

No thanks.
